thread:
Sam - CS: Quick post-all-hands ask: drop one line on why we won/lost the deals mentioned so we can triage.
Iris - Product: Win: BrightLabs picked us for predictable per-token pricing + console traceability; their engineers liked rollout fallbacks.
Nate - Sales: Loss: Keystone Bank pushed for HSM + SOC2 timeline; procurement paused since our cert timeline didn't match theirs.
Rex - Eng: Keystone tech note: very long documents caused tail latency; we prototyped a prefix-cache/kv workaround but need validation and a short runbook.
Sam - CS: From CS notes: recurring wins = fast POC, clear perf metrics; recurring losses = missing certs, HSM docs, and on-prem cookbooks.
Jared - CEO: OK actionables: 1) compliance battlecard for Sales; 2) Dedicated onboarding checklist; 3) short eng runbook for long-seq workloads. Iris, can Product own 1+2?
Iris - Product: I will. Need Eng + Sales reviewers — Nate can nominate.
Nate - Sales: I'll put Priya and two AEs on review. Also request a one-page RFP risk summary we can attach.
Rex - Eng: I'll own the long-seq runbook. ETA next Tue. Will include a minimal code snippet and canary steps.
lifecycle-bot: Created ticket RW-1720 "all-hands: enterprise triage & runbook" and assigned to Iris + Rex.
Jared - CEO: Thanks. Keep updates short in this thread; ping when drafts are ready. :rocket:
